wall_seconds 达到 180 秒上限即停止

basis: The task is a single deterministic review: read four fixed input artifacts, apply six checks per service, and emit one schema-conforming JSON object.
No independent parallel branches or structured review are needed; work is sequential over three service reports against one policy.
No tool calls or iterative correction are required, so an open loop entry is sufficient within the 180-second budget.
stop_conditions: Stop once release_review.json satisfies the deliverable schema and every check, blocker, and evidence_ref is derived only from the four supplied input artifacts.
Stop if any input artifact cannot be read, leaving the review incomplete with no other source permitted.
